_note: Oldest-end sweep batch 78: 10-12 July 2026. Model claude-opus-5, prompt v1.

mentions.claim_text: He notes a story dated July the 10th of 2026 that they are wanting to start buying Bitcoin, and says that is just like the Lord said, to watch Japan for they will be the Sooners with South Korea and they will be seen to rise up first.
mentions.quote: watch Japan for they will be the Sooners with South Korea
mentions.falsify_match: Japanese and Korean crypto moves preceding the American ones.
mentions.falsify_miss: America moves first. Second fulfilment assertion for this claim in three days, both resting on the same undated original word, which is what needs dating before either counts.

mentions.claim_text: He says cancers and things like that will be something of the past like polio and that you can take a shot or whatever, that there will be a modern wave of healing developments people will embrace, and then that he saw a horned demon wrap itself around the internet waves, recalling that the Lord said 2027, 2028, 2029 and 2030 bring socialist control over the internet spreading through Canada and Europe, taking hold of live streams so people cannot say what they want, with a spider building a web around First Amendment rights.
mentions.quote: cancers and things like that will be being be something of the past like polio
mentions.falsify_match: A treatment that makes common cancers routinely preventable or curable.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. No date, no cancer named, and no threshold for something of the past. The 2027 to 2030 window in this passage belongs to the internet claim, not to this one.

mentions.claim_text: He says they will be able to read private files on computers in Europe and it cannot be stopped, that they voted to pass it, that they can go in through back doors to look at Instagram, private emails and other accounts though not WhatsApp, that there is no privacy and now they are simply telling you so, and that Europe passed this this week which goes along with a word the Lord gave them four or five weeks ago.
mentions.quote: able to read it in Europe and you you can't stop them
mentions.falsify_match: A European measure passed in that week authorising access to private communications.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such measure, or one that predates the word. He is unsure of his own origin date, four weeks or five, which leaves a fortnight of slack in a claim whose whole force is that the word came first.

mentions.claim_text: He says believers should lay aside petty differences under the shared testimony of grace, that they are burning your churches just like the Lord said, that the Lord said it will wake up a giant and they will overplay their hand and more and more of it will be seen, and that it is time for the church to preach repentance and holiness back because there will be no revival or great awakening without true repentance.
mentions.quote: they're burning your churches just like the Lord said
mentions.falsify_match: A rising count of church fires followed by a visible church resurgence.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. More and more of it has no rate attached, and the giant waking is unmeasurable. No revival without true repentance also supplies the reason in advance for a revival that does not arrive.

mentions.claim_text: He discusses a report that Israel found tunnels in Lebanon that were not cross-border but held military equipment, mortars, RPGs and launchers probably used to make missiles, and says he had said he saw an attack coming in the night that was worse than October the 7th.
mentions.quote: I saw a attack coming in the night that was worse than
mentions.falsify_match: A night attack on Israel exceeding October 7th.
mentions.falsify_miss: None offered here. Weapons found in tunnels is not an attack, so this is preparation being read as partial fulfilment of an event that has not occurred.

mentions.claim_text: He says he sees them raising up enough voices to try to impeach Trump and presenting it as the more civilised diplomatic way, that he sees the judges, that this election is so important concerning the next two years, that people will say they said the same in 2024 but it is even more so now given what they had planned, and that it gives more time to stand.
mentions.quote: this election is so important concerning the next into this next two years
mentions.falsify_match: An impeachment push after the midterms.
mentions.falsify_miss: No push. He answers the obvious objection himself, that this was said in 2024 too, and the answer is that it is even more important now, which is the same answer available every cycle.

mentions.claim_text: He asks whether it says when they are supposed to be finished with that ballroom, answers 2027, and says he does not know why he sees 2027.
mentions.quote: 2027. I I I I don't know why I see 2027
mentions.falsify_match: The White House ballroom completed in 2027.
mentions.falsify_miss: It is finished in another year. This is the cleanest test in the batch: a single building with a completion date, publicly reported, and he says outright he does not know why he sees it.

mentions.claim_text: He says that when the mantle and glory come on him he can feel it and see what is coming, that he must spend time with God because he was distracted by his septic and other things and it was dry, that it is not a microwave but a process and the more time you spend the more the switch turns on, and that if you try to operate underneath that glory without the switch on you will get familiar spirits and demonic stuff.
mentions.quote: if you try to operate underneath that glory without the switch on
mentions.condition_text: if you operate in the glory without spending the time first
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: an internal state with no external test.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a. Worth keeping as an unprompted admission that his accuracy varies with how much time he has had, and that a dry day is attributable to household distractions.

mentions.claim_text: He says he told them the Lord said they are going to burn down your churches, naming the Islamic Brotherhood, that they gave that word in May and today is July and it is manifesting, that the words are happening faster, and that this is just New York while they also saw burning in the UK, Ireland and Canada.
mentions.quote: The Lord gave us the word in May and today's July and it's manifesting
mentions.falsify_match: Church fires in the named places after May, attributable to the named group.
mentions.falsify_miss: The fires predate the word, or no attribution holds. Both ends are dated, May and July, so the sequence is checkable; the attribution to the Islamic Brotherhood is the part that would need separate evidence and is not offered.

mentions.claim_text: He says he only reveals what he feels peace about revealing, that some things he now sees in the news start to weird him out, that the Lord said some things they will see stopped and some they will not, and that with the Fourth of July he saw so much detail.
mentions.quote: some things you'll see that you'll stop some things you will not
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a. Some you will stop and some you will not covers every possible outcome in advance, and withholding the detail he says he saw removes what would be checked.

mentions.claim_text: He says it is the seventh month and he saw the number seven on fire, and that the Lord said there is an acceleration of war and an acceleration of the cleansing of his church with refiner's fire, for he will increase, citing 1 Corinthians 5:5 after correcting himself from 2 Corinthians.
mentions.quote: An acceleration of war, an acceleration of the cleansing of my church
mentions.falsify_match: War and church scandals both accelerating during July.
mentions.falsify_miss: Neither accelerates. Acceleration has no baseline, so it cannot be measured either way. Now past due.

mentions.claim_text: He says he does not try to pinpoint time because he sees and hears in part and does not want to be flaky, that Daniel saw things still not come to pass thousands of years later and people would call him a false prophet though he is in the Bible, that when you see it this close in the spirit you think it is tomorrow but it is years, that Poland is now happening, and that he warned about this over a year ago on July the 11th of last year on another channel.
mentions.quote: you think it's tomorrow, but it's years
mentions.falsify_match: The Poland word datable to 11 July 2025 and events following it.
mentions.falsify_miss: The appearance is datable and checkable, which makes this the strongest part of the passage. The rest is a general defence: Daniel's unfulfilled visions are offered as the reason an unfulfilled claim is not a failed one, which retires the deadline from every dated claim in the corpus at once.
